description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincially owned and operated retail liquor outlet, part of the BCLIQUOR chain of 198 stores across British Columbia. This single-storey location on Dunsmuir Avenue stocks a broad range of wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders. It is wheelchair accessible and accepts cash, credit, and debit, making it a convenient resupply stop for touring cyclists needing to pick up beverages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record has a recent check_date of 2025-09-25 and looks_closed=false, confirming this is an active BC Liquor Store at 2700 Dunsmuir Avenue. The fetched website is the corporate BCLIQUOR homepage confirming the brand operates 198 stores province-wide, but no pages specific to this location were retrieved, so no cyclist amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) can be confirmed. OSM tags confirm wheelchair accessibility, cash/credit/debit payment, and no drive-through, but none of the cyclist-specific criteria can be verified from available evidence.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the corporate BCLIQUOR homepage only; no store-specific page was fetched, so the local phone number and address could not be cross-checked against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible provincial liquor retailer with a recent OSM check date. A useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.
